nodes.name: 关联预算与市场指标计算经营 KPI

config.requirements: 按期间和业务线关联实际经营数据、预算目标及市场宏观指标，确定性计算收入预算达成、毛利、毛利率、费用率、现金偏差、应收及库存占收入比例。
config.script: SELECT f.period, f.business_line, f.revenue_wan, b.budget_revenue_wan, ROUND(f.revenue_wan / NULLIF(b.budget_revenue_wan, 0) * 100, 2) AS revenue_budget_attainment_pct, ROUND(f.revenue_wan - b.budget_revenue_wan, 2) AS revenue_budget_variance_wan, f.cost_wan, ROUND(f.revenue_wan - f.cost_wan, 2) AS gross_profit_wan, ROUND((f.revenue_wan - f.cost_wan) / NULLIF(f.revenue_wan, 0) * 100, 2) AS gross_margin_pct, b.budget_gross_margin_pct, ROUND((f.revenue_wan - f.cost_wan) / NULLIF(f.revenue_wan, 0) * 100 - b.budget_gross_margin_pct, 2) AS gross_margin_gap_pct, f.selling_expense_wan, f.admin_expense_wan, f.r_and_d_wan, ROUND((f.selling_expense_wan + f.admin_expense_wan + f.r_and_d_wan) / NULLIF(f.revenue_wan, 0) * 100, 2) AS operating_expense_ratio_pct, f.receivables_wan, ROUND(f.receivables_wan / NULLIF(f.revenue_wan, 0) * 100, 2) AS receivables_to_revenue_pct, f.inventory_wan, ROUND(f.inventory_wan / NULLIF(f.revenue_wan, 0) * 100, 2) AS inventory_to_revenue_pct, f.operating_cash_flow_wan, b.budget_cash_flow_wan, ROUND(f.operating_cash_flow_wan - b.budget_cash_flow_wan, 2) AS cash_flow_budget_variance_wan, f.order_backlog_wan, m.new_energy_equipment_index, m.lithium_material_price_index, m.eur_cny, m.manufacturing_pmi, m.policy_attention_index FROM financials f LEFT JOIN budget b ON f.period = b.period AND f.business_line = b.business_line LEFT JOIN market m ON f.period = m.period ORDER BY f.period, f.business_line
config.outputName: 启明智造经营KPI关联明细.csv

nodes.name: 汇总管理层经营质量指标

config.requirements: 分别按总体、业务线和月份汇总收入、预算、毛利、现金流、应收、库存与订单，所有结论必须以该汇总为唯一金额口径。
config.script: WITH d AS (SELECT * FROM detail), s AS (SELECT '总体' AS dimension_type, '2026上半年' AS dimension_name, SUM(revenue_wan) AS revenue_wan, SUM(budget_revenue_wan) AS budget_revenue_wan, SUM(gross_profit_wan) AS gross_profit_wan, SUM(operating_cash_flow_wan) AS operating_cash_flow_wan, SUM(budget_cash_flow_wan) AS budget_cash_flow_wan, SUM(receivables_wan) AS receivables_wan, SUM(inventory_wan) AS inventory_wan, SUM(order_backlog_wan) AS order_backlog_wan FROM d UNION ALL SELECT '业务线', business_line, SUM(revenue_wan), SUM(budget_revenue_wan), SUM(gross_profit_wan), SUM(operating_cash_flow_wan), SUM(budget_cash_flow_wan), SUM(receivables_wan), SUM(inventory_wan), SUM(order_backlog_wan) FROM d GROUP BY business_line UNION ALL SELECT '月份', period, SUM(revenue_wan), SUM(budget_revenue_wan), SUM(gross_profit_wan), SUM(operating_cash_flow_wan), SUM(budget_cash_flow_wan), SUM(receivables_wan), SUM(inventory_wan), SUM(order_backlog_wan) FROM d GROUP BY period) SELECT dimension_type, dimension_name, ROUND(revenue_wan, 2) AS revenue_wan, ROUND(budget_revenue_wan, 2) AS budget_revenue_wan, ROUND(revenue_wan / NULLIF(budget_revenue_wan, 0) * 100, 2) AS revenue_budget_attainment_pct, ROUND(gross_profit_wan, 2) AS gross_profit_wan, ROUND(gross_profit_wan / NULLIF(revenue_wan, 0) * 100, 2) AS gross_margin_pct, ROUND(operating_cash_flow_wan, 2) AS operating_cash_flow_wan, ROUND(budget_cash_flow_wan, 2) AS budget_cash_flow_wan, ROUND(operating_cash_flow_wan - budget_cash_flow_wan, 2) AS cash_flow_budget_variance_wan, ROUND(receivables_wan, 2) AS receivables_wan, ROUND(inventory_wan, 2) AS inventory_wan, ROUND(order_backlog_wan, 2) AS order_backlog_wan FROM s ORDER BY CASE dimension_type WHEN '总体' THEN 1 WHEN '业务线' THEN 2 ELSE 3 END, dimension_name
config.outputName: 启明智造管理层经营质量汇总.csv

nodes.name: LLM 综合经营与市场分析

config.prompt: 你是上市公司财务分析负责人。请综合上游经营KPI明细、管理层汇总、同业基准、大客户风险和知识Ref，形成2026年上半年经营与资本市场联合分析。金额和比例必须逐项沿用结构化数据，不得自行重新加总；媒体、研报、管理层讨论只能用于解释，不得覆盖结构化事实。内容必须包括：1. 一句话总体判断；2. 总体及三条业务线的收入、预算达成率、毛利率和订单；3. 月度趋势及锂材料价格、PMI、欧元汇率等外部指标的可能影响，明确区分事实与推断；4. 经营现金流与收入利润背离；5. 应收和库存风险；6. Top5客户集中度及逾期情况；7. 与行业中位数及三家同业比较；8. 管理层需要决策的收入质量、回款、库存、定价、采购、汇率和研发事项；9. 给出30天、90天和半年行动计划。所有公司和资料均为模拟案例，报告不构成投资建议。
